title: Hostel Facilities - AJAY KUMAR GARG ENGINEERING COLLEGE
text: Hostel Facilities Hostel Overview The college is full of lush green look having hostel facilities for the boys and girls students. The college has 03 hostels for the boys and 03 hostels for the girls students . The hostel facility for the boys and girls are separately located in the college campus. All the hostels are uniquely designed to make them quite airy having adequate cross ventilation, lighting and indoor / out door sports facilities. The hostel facility in the college is limited. The students interested in availing the hostel facility are required to fill the attached hostel registration form. All the hostel registration forms will be submitted for consideration of the Hostel Allotment Committee. The students whose hostel registration forms are approved for allotment of hostel facility, will be required to pay the hostel fee on the registration / reporting day itself. The students who fail to pay the hostel fee within 24 hours, will be considered as cancelled and other students in the waiting list will be considered for allotment of hostel. The college provides Non- AC double seater and limited triple seater rooms for 1st year boys students and only Non-AC triple seater rooms for 1st year girls students. The details of hostels available for 1st year students are as given below.
